settings.title: Settings
settings.welcomeSubtitle: Choose how Vibe Board should appear while your agents are working.

effects.title: Island appearance effect
effects.desc: Pick an appearance effect; it is saved and applied to the desktop island immediately. Idle shows only the icon; while running, only the working Agent name is shown, without task names, quotas, counters, or the gear.
effects.midnightDesc: Opaque black surface, the default look that hugs the screen edge.
effects.frostedGlassDesc: Translucent light glass that blurs and reveals the desktop behind it.
effects.currentOther: The current color theme is "{{name}}", which is neither Midnight black nor Frosted glass. Picking an effect below switches immediately.

island.desc: Configure the dynamic island appearance, behavior, sounds, and integrations.
